text: Quadratic formula: for ax^2 + bx + c = 0 (a != 0), x = (-b +/- sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)) / (2a). The discriminant D = b^2 - 4ac decides the roots: D > 0 two real roots, D = 0 one repeated root, D < 0 no real roots.
subject: math

text: Laws of indices: a^m * a^n = a^(m+n); a^m / a^n = a^(m-n); (a^m)^n = a^(mn); a^0 = 1 for a != 0; a^(-n) = 1/a^n; a^(1/n) = the n-th root of a.
subject: math

text: Laws of logarithms: log(xy) = log x + log y; log(x/y) = log x - log y; log(x^n) = n log x; log_a a = 1; log_a 1 = 0; change of base log_a x = (log_b x)/(log_b a).
subject: math

text: Arithmetic progression (AP): nth term T_n = a + (n-1)d; sum S_n = (n/2)(2a + (n-1)d) = (n/2)(a + l) where a is the first term, d the common difference, l the last term.
subject: math

text: Geometric progression (GP): nth term T_n = a r^(n-1); sum of n terms S_n = a(r^n - 1)/(r - 1) for r != 1; sum to infinity S = a/(1 - r) when |r| < 1.
subject: math

text: Circle: circumference = 2*pi*r; area = pi*r^2. Sector of angle theta degrees: arc length = (theta/360)*2*pi*r; area = (theta/360)*pi*r^2.
subject: math

text: Solids: cuboid volume = l*w*h; cube volume = a^3, surface area = 6a^2; cylinder volume = pi*r^2*h, curved surface = 2*pi*r*h, total surface = 2*pi*r(r+h); sphere volume = (4/3)*pi*r^3, surface area = 4*pi*r^2; cone volume = (1/3)*pi*r^2*h.
subject: math

text: Right-angled triangle (SOHCAHTOA): sin = opposite/hypotenuse, cos = adjacent/hypotenuse, tan = opposite/adjacent. Pythagoras: hypotenuse^2 = opposite^2 + adjacent^2.
subject: math

text: Trig identities: sin^2(x) + cos^2(x) = 1; tan(x) = sin(x)/cos(x). Sine rule: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C. Cosine rule: a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc cos A.
subject: math

text: Differentiation: d/dx(x^n) = n*x^(n-1); d/dx(constant) = 0; the derivative gives the gradient/rate of change. Product, quotient and chain rules extend this to combinations.
subject: math

text: Integration (reverse of differentiation): integral of x^n dx = x^(n+1)/(n+1) + C for n != -1. The definite integral from a to b gives the area under the curve between x = a and x = b.
subject: math

text: Statistics: mean = (sum of values)/(number of values); for grouped data mean = (sum of f*x)/(sum of f). Median is the middle value when ordered; mode is the most frequent value. Range = highest - lowest.
subject: math

text: Probability of an event = (number of favourable outcomes)/(total number of equally likely outcomes), a value between 0 and 1. For independent events A and B, P(A and B) = P(A)*P(B). For mutually exclusive events, P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B).
subject: math

text: Equations of motion (constant acceleration a): v = u + at; s = ut + (1/2)a t^2; v^2 = u^2 + 2as; s = ((u+v)/2)t. Here u is initial velocity, v final velocity, s displacement, t time.
subject: physics

text: Newton's second law: force F = mass m * acceleration a (F = ma), in newtons. Weight W = mg where g is the acceleration due to gravity (about 9.8 or 10 m/s^2 in most WAEC problems). Momentum p = mv.
subject: physics

text: Energy and work: work done W = force * distance (in the direction of the force), in joules. Kinetic energy KE = (1/2)m v^2. Gravitational potential energy PE = mgh. Power = work done / time = energy / time, in watts.
subject: physics

text: Ohm's law: voltage V = current I * resistance R (V = IR). Electrical power P = VI = I^2 R = V^2/R. Charge Q = I * t (current times time), in coulombs. Resistors in series add: R = R1 + R2 + ...
subject: physics

text: Waves: wave speed v = frequency f * wavelength lambda (v = f*lambda). Period T = 1/f. Sound travels about 340 m/s in air; light about 3.0 x 10^8 m/s in a vacuum.
subject: physics

text: The mole: one mole contains Avogadro's number, 6.02 x 10^23, of particles. Number of moles n = mass / molar mass. For gases at STP, one mole occupies 22.4 dm^3 (litres).
subject: chemistry

text: Acids and bases: an acid releases H+ ions in water; a base/alkali releases OH- ions. pH = -log[H+]; pH < 7 is acidic, 7 is neutral, > 7 is basic. Acid + base -> salt + water (neutralisation).
subject: chemistry

text: Periodic table trends: across a period atomic radius decreases and electronegativity increases; down a group atomic radius increases and metallic character increases. Group 1 = alkali metals, Group 7 = halogens, Group 0/8 = noble gases.
subject: chemistry

text: Atomic structure: an atom has protons (positive) and neutrons in the nucleus, with electrons (negative) in shells. Atomic number = number of protons; mass number = protons + neutrons. Isotopes have the same atomic number but different mass numbers.
subject: chemistry

text: The cell is the basic unit of life. Plant cells have a cell wall, chloroplasts and a large vacuole; animal cells do not. Both have a cell membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus and mitochondria (the site of respiration).
subject: biology

text: Genetics: genes carry hereditary information; alleles are alternative forms of a gene. In a monohybrid cross of two heterozygous parents (Aa x Aa), the offspring ratio is 3 dominant : 1 recessive. Genotype is the genes present; phenotype is the observable trait.
subject: biology

text: Ecology: a food chain shows energy flow from producers (green plants) to consumers to decomposers. A food web is interlinked food chains. Photosynthesis makes glucose using carbon dioxide, water and light; respiration releases energy from glucose.
subject: biology
